notes.title: Updated to Version 1.1.6
notes.content:
Hey guys, I pushed a little update with a few fixes.

Changes in version 1.1.6:
	Fixed the hitbox of heart-shaped bullets.
	Made some minor improvements to the leaderboards.
	Lance's damage has been buffed a tiny bit.
	No-bullet-clear handicap now gives you the bullets-cleared score bonus - making possible hiscores even higher.
	Gallery button added to options to make border options easier to find.
	Added some more borders.

Also some people have mentioned a problem where mouse movement lags when a key is held down. I haven't found a solution to this yet - it seems to be an issue with Flash - but there's some workarounds. You can turn on Filter Keys and disable key-repeating on your computer, and that should help. Also you can try to just not mix mouse and keyboard controls. 
Sorry about that.

This might be my last post before Christmas, so Merry Christmas!
